title: The Rival Miners
text: Another House's miners are already working the seam you came for, their banner planted in the spoil heap. They stop swinging their picks when they see you. Their overseer counts your number, then counts his own.

options.label: Share the seam with them; there is enough iron for two Houses.

outcomes.text: You split it half and half, and nobody draws steel.

options.label: Drive them off the seam. You came for it first, whatever their banner says.

outcomes.text: They go. They will remember, and so will their House.

options.label: The shrewdest tricks them into leaving so no blood is spilled.

outcomes.text: They hear of a better seam a day's walk off, and thank you for the rumor.
